thread:
alex: Heads-up — user reported a reconnect case where a resumed stream caused a toolcall to be charged twice after truncation. Repro steps + logs below.

maria: Do we still create provisional tokens on stream chunks? I thought we only confirmed on final ack.

sam: Short answer: we create provisional at chunk commit (prefix). Confirmed on completion, but the bug is routing + resume can create a second confirmed charge without reconciling the provisional.

hao: Is this the fallback->truncate->resume flow? Any logs?

alex: Yup. Sequence: client starts stream -> routerA routes to node1 -> partial chunk commits (provisional) -> a fallback policy truncates the toolcall (early EOF) -> client reconnects -> routerB routes to node2 which doesn't see provisional -> processes remaining toolcall and emits a confirmed charge. Result: provisional + confirmed both billed.

jess: Can we dedupe on client session id? If the client supplies a stable session_id we could stitch.

maria: We tried that in pilot but mobile clients often rotate session ids. Need server-side correlation.

billing-bot: note: provisional entries auto-expire after 60s. If resume happens within that window we attempt stitching; beyond that we consider provisional orphaned.

sam: Proposal: propagate a resume token in router headers so any new path sees previous provisional id. Something like `X-Resume-Token: <provisional_id>` stored in short-lived session cache (ttl ~120s).

alex: Also need console changes: surface provisional vs confirmed per-route so support can quickly see if double-charge happened. Current per-route view only shows confirmed tokens.

maria: UX thought: don't clutter graphs. Add a toggle for "include provisional" and a small "provisional reconciliation" panel with a net delta.

hao: Edge case: toolcall retries + toolcall idempotency. If client retries the same toolcall we must dedupe by (toolcall_id + resume_token) not just resume_token.

jess: Ops API idea: internal endpoint `/internal/ledger/trace?resume_token=...` that returns provisional/confirmed rows for debugging. Gate behind internal auth.

sam: Implementation checklist: 1) router header injection, 2) session cache shard + TTL, 3) ledger lookup endpoint, 4) console panel + toggle, 5) add tracing flag to router to include `X-Resume-Token` in logs.

alex: Quick config snippet I mocked for router header insertion:```
# router config snippet
headers:
  X-Resume-Token: "{{ provisional_id }}"
```

alex: Example log excerpt (simplified):```
INFO routerA: alloc provisional_id=prov_abc123 chunk=42 session=mobile_xyz
WARN middleware: truncation at toolcall boundary toolcall_id=t42 session=mobile_xyz
INFO routerB: resume request no-prov found session=mobile_xyz -> issuing confirmed charge final_tokens=67
INFO ledger: write provisional prov_abc123 tokens=12
INFO ledger: write confirmed conf_def456 tokens=67
```

maria: Security note: ledger lookup must not leak prompt contents or PII; return only token counts, route ids, timestamps.

jess: I'll draft the internal API contract. Sam + Alex, can you pick up the router + ledger changes?

sam: I'll take router patch and header propagation. Alex can own the session cache and ledger stitching logic.

alex: On it. I'll also add a reconciliation job that periodically scans orphaned provisionals and emits support alerts if net delta > threshold.

maria: I'll mock console panels by EOD and open a PR to `eng-console` with screenshots. Filing a bug now and assigning to the above. :thumbsup:
